review.notes: Sam bargains the fare with the driver Deepak and gives directions (सीधा चलो, दाएँ मुड़ो, यहाँ रुकिए); commands, future, comparison with से (सस्ता). The plan has "से कम"; कम is taught later, so the comparison uses से ... सस्ता. मोड़ is only used in frames the adapter reads as a noun (एक मोड़ है; मोड़ पर). "बारिश में भीगना पड़ता है" reuses the weather words. The testimony words come back in the talk between Sam and Deepak. Honorific plural is not used for दीपक भाई (peer). Words outside the plan (measured, adapter lemmas x tokens): मुड़ना×3 (to turn; needed for directions), बंद×1, यहीं×1 (under-met).

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: आज सैम को स्टेशन जाना है।
sentences.english: Today Sam has to go to the station.
He is running late.
It is raining outside.
The weather is cold today.

sentences.text: हवा चल रही है, और सर्दी लगती है।
sentences.english: The wind is blowing, and it feels chilly.
It is very cold.
Yesterday there was sunshine.
There are clouds in the sky.
There is the sound of lightning too.
He has no umbrella.
Sam gets wet.
There is an auto on the road.

sentences.text: ऑटो के पास एक आदमी खड़ा है।
sentences.english: A man is standing near the auto.
His name is Deepak.

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "नमस्ते, दीपक भाई! मुझे स्टेशन जाना है।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "Hello, Deepak bhai! I have to go to the station."

sentences.text: दीपक बोलता है, "आइए, बैठिए। यह ऑटो अच्छा है।"
sentences.english: Deepak says, "Come, sit. This auto is good."

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "स्टेशन का किराया क्या है?"
sentences.english: Sam says, "What is the fare to the station?"
Deepak says, "80 rupees."

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "यह बहुत महँगा है! क़ीमत ठीक नहीं है।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "That is very expensive! The price is not right."

sentences.text: दीपक बोलता है, "बारिश में क़ीमत महँगी होती है।"
sentences.english: Deepak says, "In the rain the price is high."

sentences.text: दीपक बोलता है, "आज बारिश है, तो किराया महँगा है।"
sentences.english: Deepak says, "Today it is raining, so the fare is high."

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "कल का किराया इससे सस्ता था।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "Yesterday's fare was cheaper than this."
Deepak says, "All right, 60 rupees."
Sam says, "I will give 50 rupees."
Deepak says, "55."

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "ठीक है। अब ठीक है।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "All right. Now it is fine."

sentences.text: सैम को यह क़ीमत पसंद आती है।
sentences.english: Sam likes this price.
Deepak opens the door.
Sam sits inside.
Sam tells the way.
Sam says, "Go straight."
"There is a crossroads ahead."
"Turn right at the crossroads."
"There is a bend there."
"Turn left at this bend."
"Then turn left."
"There is a shop on the right."
"There is a garden on the left."
"In front of the garden there is a shop."
The shopkeeper says, "Stop!"
At the bend the shopkeeper laughs.

sentences.text: दुकानदार बोलता है, "आप कहाँ जाते हैं?"
sentences.english: The shopkeeper says, "Where are you going?"
Deepak says, "Go straight."
"The straight road is good."
Children play in the garden.
On the right there is the ghat.
There are many people at the ghat.
Near the ghat there is the river.
Just then the car stops.
There are many cars at the crossroads.
Sam gets angry.
Ten minutes pass.
Deepak says, "The road is closed."
"Go this way."
"Everything is fine this way."

sentences.text: दीपक बोलता है, "मेरी सवारी स्टेशन जाती है।"
sentences.english: Deepak says, "My passenger is going to the station."
"Today in the rain there are many passengers."
"A passenger takes a rickshaw."

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "रिक्शा सस्ता है, लेकिन बारिश में भीगना पड़ता है।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "A rickshaw is cheap, but you have to get wet in the rain."

sentences.text: दीपक बोलता है, "हाँ, रिक्शा भीग जाता है।"
sentences.english: Deepak says, "Yes, a rickshaw gets wet."

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "कल मैं भी नहीं लूँगा।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "Tomorrow I will not take one either."

sentences.text: दीपक पूछता है, "आप कहाँ से हैं, सैम भाई?"
sentences.english: Deepak asks, "Where are you from, Sam bhai?"

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "मैं दूर से हूँ। यहाँ मैं अजनबी था।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "I am from far away. Here I was a stranger."

sentences.text: दीपक बोलता है, "अब आप अजनबी नहीं हैं।"
sentences.english: Deepak says, "Now you are not a stranger."

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "मैं कलीसिया जाता हूँ। वहाँ प्यार है।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "I go to the church. There is love there."
"God saved my life."
"I give my testimony to everyone."

sentences.text: दीपक बोलता है, "दुनिया में सब यह नहीं मानते।"
sentences.english: Deepak says, "Not everyone in the world believes this."

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "मैं किसी से कुछ नहीं माँगता, भाई।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "I do not ask anything from anyone, brother."
Deepak laughs.

sentences.text: गाड़ी स्टेशन के पास पहुँचती है।
sentences.english: The car reaches the station.

sentences.text: दीपक बोलता है, "यहाँ से मैं लौटूँगा।"
sentences.english: Deepak says, "From here I will turn back."

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "मैं शाम को लौटूँगा। आप आएँगे?"
sentences.english: Sam says, "I will come back in the evening. Will you come?"

sentences.text: दीपक बोलता है, "हाँ, मैं यहीं लौटूँगा।"
sentences.english: Deepak says, "Yes, I will come back right here."
Sam pays.
He says, "Thank you, Deepak bhai!"
Sam opens the door and gets out.

sentences.text: स्टेशन पर रवि सर इंतज़ार करते हैं।
sentences.english: Ravi sir is waiting at the station.

sentences.text: वह बोलते हैं, "सैम, आप भीग गए!"
sentences.english: He says, "Sam, you are wet!"

sentences.text: सैम बोलता है, "हाँ, सर, लेकिन मैं ख़ुश हूँ।"
sentences.english: Sam says, "Yes, sir, but I am happy."

sentences.text: रवि सर बोलते हैं, "आइए, पहले चाय पीजिए।"
sentences.english: Ravi sir says, "Come, have tea first."
Sam drinks tea.

sentences.text: चाय गरम है, और सैम बहुत ख़ुश है।
sentences.english: The tea is hot, and Sam is very happy.

sentences.text: दोनों ट्रेन का इंतज़ार करते हैं।
sentences.english: The two of them wait for the train.
